This is a new prospective construction-only amendment; it does not rewrite either predecessor or claim either predecessor passed.

source_ancestry.reason_for_later_commit: R002 requires a new contact-consistent SE(3) constructor, finite schedule, failure-retaining launcher, and validator. A separate source-push gate must bind the final pushed implementation commit before the first live R002 candidate evaluation.

predecessor_outcomes.claim_boundary: Neither predecessor candidate gate passed. R002 cannot alter, replace, or reinterpret predecessor artifacts or results.

engineering_rationale_only: R001 retained evidence showed that cameras, exact reset, and companion gates generally passed while independently averaging robot joints and cube poses produced unstable contact, excessive velocities, and/or OOD states. This motivates contact-consistent SE(3) construction only. No R001 policy behavior exists, and no R001 failed metric is used to change a scientific threshold.

candidate_search.order_rationale: The lower-intervention direct initialization family precedes the independently prespecified normal-contact approach fallback. Within each family cross-anchored LEFT/reflected-RIGHT combinations precede same-anchor combinations. This order is frozen before live evaluation and does not use an R002 gate result.
candidate_search.acceptance: A candidate rank passes only if independently constructed canonical_grasp and canonical_carry states both pass every unchanged scientific, OOD, camera, companion, contact, reset, runtime, and source gate.
candidate_search.first_pass_rule: Evaluate ranks 1 through 8 serially and stop at the first complete passing pair.
candidate_search.exhaustion: If ranks 1 through 8 all fail, close R002 with zero model requests and zero behavioral episodes. Never add candidates, reorder candidates, change a construction parameter, or relax a gate after live inspection.

geometry_contract.reflection: For M=diag(1,-1,1), reflect both RIGHT world poses as p'=M p and R'=M R M, then recompute T_eef_cube=inv(T_world_eef') T_world_cube'. Never reflect a local relative vector directly.
geometry_contract.direction_balanced_target_cube: x and z are arithmetic midpoints of LEFT and reflected-RIGHT source cube positions; y is exactly 0; orientation is the shortest-arc SO(3) geodesic midpoint of LEFT and reflected-RIGHT source cube orientations with deterministic canonical-quaternion tie handling.
geometry_contract.contact_transform: Each variant preserves exactly either the observed LEFT T_eef_cube or the correctly world-reflected RIGHT T_eef_cube. It never averages robot joints independently of the cube and never averages contact transforms.
geometry_contract.centerline_constrained_eef_target: Derive T_world_eef = T_world_cube_target @ inv(T_eef_cube_selected). The scientific midline constraint applies to the reconstructed cube, not the EEF. Record target/achieved EEF and reconstructed cube plus SE(3) residuals.

construction_contract.fresh_environment_lifecycle: For each candidate rank and stage, use one exact-reset IK-solve environment and a separate exact-reset materialization environment; close both before the next stage. Contact sensors are initialized and coverage-checked in the materialization environment.

deterministic_ik.controller: exact E004 absolute differential-IK action interface and EEF offset
deterministic_ik.initial_state: exact E004 s=1 reset; no prompt/action history is retained
deterministic_ik.verification: finite solution, exact FK residual log, and every solved joint inside the environment-provided soft joint limits

direct_contact_initialization.write_order: In the fresh materialization environment after exact reset validation, atomically write solved seven arm joints, selected exact historical six gripper joints, target cube pose reconstructed from selected T_eef_cube, and zero robot/cube velocities; set joint targets; write scene; forward without a physics integration step.
direct_contact_initialization.hold: Command the fixed registered EEF target with normal binary close action 1.0 for exactly 260 physics steps; evaluate the final 10 consecutive steps.
direct_contact_initialization.prohibitions: no weld, attachment, collision suppression, force injection, learned policy, prompt-conditioned action, or physics step before the normal closed hold

open_approach_close_lift.initial_state: fresh exact E004 reset; cube and every companion remain at reset
open_approach_close_lift.approach: command the registered contact EEF pose plus 0.060 m world-z clearance, gripper 0.0, for 50 steps
open_approach_close_lift.descent: linearly interpolate world position over 50 steps to the exact contact EEF pose at the reset cube while holding registered orientation and gripper 0.0
open_approach_close_lift.close: hold contact EEF pose with normal binary close action 1.0 for 60 steps
open_approach_close_lift.lift: linearly interpolate world position and shortest-arc orientation over 60 steps to the registered final EEF target while holding close action 1.0
open_approach_close_lift.settle: hold the registered final EEF target with close action 1.0 for 100 steps; evaluate the final 10 consecutive steps
open_approach_close_lift.prohibitions: no direct cube write, weld, attachment, collision suppression, force injection, learned policy, or prompt-conditioned action

construction_contract.velocities: direct initialization writes every robot joint velocity and cube linear/angular velocity to exact zero; open construction uses normal physics only
construction_contract.history: All construction actions, resets, and environment state are logged and excluded from behavior. A later behavioral runner must restore the accepted normalized state into a fresh environment, verify its exact registered state hash before request zero, and start fresh sampling/prompt history.
